behavior.source: Read-only local file, converted on a worker queue; source extension determines a fixed reader.
behavior.argv: Structured argv with -- before source; fixed Lua filter; no shell interpolation.
behavior.media: Existing Pandoc mediabag images and explicit notebook cell attachments are retained in a request staging directory, then committed to Application Support/<bundleID>/ImportedMedia/<UUID>. Markdown/raw HTML references use percent-encoded absolute file:// URLs.
behavior.notebook: A private read-only snapshot adds cell-scoped attachment mappings. Raw HTML image references preserve distinct same-name attachments in different cells.
behavior.cancellation: Task cancellation signals the existing process-group launcher; failed/cancelled jobs remove their staging/cache directory and temporary output.
behavior.network: --sandbox + html+raw_html; filter never calls mediabag.fetch/fill or --extract-media. Remote image references remain references.
behavior.noMedia: No persistent request directory remains when an import has no embedded media.

sources.supports: Mediabag lookup and fixed Lua AST Image transformations; actual bundled 3.12.1 execution validates the API.
Pinned local documentation of sandbox and html+raw_html iframe behavior.

limits: Persistent ImportedMedia absolute URLs are not a portable Markdown folder. Original Typora media placement still needs a behavior comparison.
The caller must create a separate unsaved MarkdownDocument and keep resourceOriginURL set to the source; App/UI integration is owned by file_preferences.
Local referenced HTML/LaTeX images remain relative to resourceOriginURL; they are not copied unless embedded in the source.
The API exposes supported reader formats, not a proof that every source feature or original Typora import format is 1:1.
Custom Pandoc versions can differ from the pinned bundled reader set.
